newsitem.title: USA: Halliburton unit wins $128 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Halliburton unit wins $128 mln contract.

text.p: Brown & Root, a unit of Halliburton Co, said on Monday it has won a $128 million contract to provide base operations support services at the Johnson Space Center of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).
The company said it received the contract with its joint venture partner, Pioneer Contract Services Inc.
It said the contract has a base period of one year, with four one-year options.

Services under the contract include plant maintenance and operations, logistics support, rigging and heavy hauling support security services, grounds maintenance, custodial services and minor construction, engineering design and painting services, it said.
